Title: Intro to vector search (conference talk)
[00:00:12] Today I'll explain what vector search is and when to use it.
[00:01:05] An embedding turns text into a list of numbers that captures meaning.
[00:03:40] Approximate nearest neighbour indexes such as HNSW trade a little recall for speed.
[00:06:22] Hybrid search combines keyword scoring with vector similarity.
[00:09:10] Evaluate with a labelled query set and measure recall at 10.
[00:11:48] A common mistake is chunking documents too large, which dilutes the embedding.
